command: GitHub Actions draft npm-shadow canary on ubuntu-22.04 for tag v1.0.10: global /usr/local npm fixture plus authenticated-draft install.sh --method binary --no-setup --yes
decisions: A global /usr/local npm 0.10.0-shaped jarn fixture was installed first on PATH and retained byte-for-byte.
The installer returned documented status 10, printed Activation required, emitted no Done or Ready, and left the new user-space binary reporting jarn 1.0.10.
A fresh login shell with the shadowed PATH resolved the new user-space command and version.
Transactional config migration contracts were covered by the exact-tag pytest collection rather than mutating this canary's empty HOME config.
result: On Ubuntu 22.04/glibc 2.35, the exact v1.0.10 draft installer replaced PATH precedence over a retained global npm fixture, preserved that fixture, and activated jarn 1.0.10 in the user-space prefix.
limitations: This canary used authenticated draft assets via a loopback GitHub fixture because draft Release URLs are not anonymously fetchable before promotion.
First-time provider setup was disabled with --no-setup to isolate command collision behavior; authentication is covered by separate UAT criteria.
